idea: Numbers & counting (Friday school readiness, long 2:30 learning song) at GRANDMA'S FARM (OUTDOOR outfit): a little orange pumpkin pops up onto the hay bale right beside Baby Jimmy ('Pop! Wow! Look! A little pumpkin!'); chorus 'One, two, three, four, five! Little pumpkins in a line! … Count with me – you're doing fine!'; each verse a new pumpkin pops onto the hay bale and he counts up – one (nod), two (clap two times), three (tap knees three times), four (stomp four times), five (show five fingers); clap break; review 'Let's count them all! One, two, three, four, five! How many pumpkins? Hmm?' (2 s pause) – 'Five! Five little pumpkins! Yay!'; loop: the hook framing with the pumpkin, bye-bye wave, more pumpkins tumble in.

learning.goal: Count real objects from 1 to 5 (one new pumpkin per verse) and answer 'How many?'
learning.shown_how: identical small orange pumpkins appear one by one on a golden hay bale beside Jimmy (1,2,3,4,5 - counted in every frame and clip check)
learning.song_repeats: chorus x4 counts 1-5; each verse counts up to its number; review counts all five at 1:48
learning.copy_me: nod one time, clap two times, tap knees three times, stomp four times, show five fingers, clap break 1:38
learning.fact_check: frames: f1/f4/f12 one, f5 two, f6 three, f7 four, f8/f10/f11 five (counted); verse cuts show the sung count (s5=2, s6=3, s7=4, s10/s11=5); s4 extra pumpkins cropped out
learning.toddler_fit: one baby, sunny farm, big face, soft round pumpkins, nothing scary

story_order: 1 pumpkin from the hook; 2 from 0:34; 3 from 1:02; 4 from 1:14; 5 from 1:26; chorus shots are close-ups/crops without a countable row
